🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No smart meter data processing without explicit consumer consent and DPIA under UK GDPR
  • ❌ No energy disconnection without vulnerability assessment and human override under Ofgem rules
  • ❌ No grid automation without safety case approval and human emergency override
  • ❌ No EV charging algorithm without rural equity impact assessment
  • ❌ No fuel poverty algorithm without equality impact assessment under Equality Act 2010
  • ❌ No CNI cyber security decision without NCSC coordination and incident reporting
